inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted average from the H1 FY2026 interim EPS note (note 8): 1,373,220,349 basic + 483,563 options + 2,860,052 awarded shares = 1,376,563,964. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count); buybacks (RMB395m FY2025, RMB337m H1 FY2026) exceed the SBC charge, so the flat count is funded. No non-SBC issuance: the 2020 convertible bonds were converted/redeemed by April 2025 and are already in the count.
inputs.debt_note: Interest-bearing bank loans RMB10.0m + lease liabilities RMB258.4m (47.459 current + 210.908 non-current), 30 June 2026 balance sheet. Lease treatment (A): liabilities in net debt, no principal deducted from the flows.
inputs.cash_note: Management's own 'cash resources' definition at 30 June 2026 (interim MD&A, Liquidity section): cash and bank deposits 24,494.1 + restricted cash 2.9 + current FVTPL wealth-management products 2,246.1 + financial assets at amortised cost 413.7 = 27,156.6. Non-current FVTPL (715.3, equity investments) excluded. RMB3,795.5m of the pile is non-RMB denominated and unhedged.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 consolidated income statement line 'Share-based compensation costs' RMB296,474k (3888.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:373), same figure as the cash-flow add-back; no cash taxes paid on net-share settlement are disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0), so no equity-award tax is added.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. fx_rate is HKD per CNY = 1.1739 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22). Direction check: the inverse pair HKDCNY=X printed 0.851 the same day, 1/0.851 = 1.1751, a 0.1% tie. No dual listing of 3888.HK exists for a parity check; Kingsoft Cloud (3896.HK, held 32.94%) is converted with the same rate for the bridge. Per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by fx_rate into HKD for the canonical fields; CNY twins are the suffixed fields.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% risk-free + 1.1 beta x ~7% China equity risk premium = ~9.5% cost of equity; no debt, so WACC = 9.5%. No ad-hoc premium for the holdco structure or games cyclicality: those risks are carried in the scenario paths and weights (charged once). Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB258.4m (30 June 2026) sit in total_debt; lease principal (RMB23.4m FY2025) is NOT deducted from the flows; D&A includes right-of-use depreciation. The new office lease taken in H1 FY2026 (ROU assets 318 -> 545m) is why the liability jumped; immaterial at ~RMB0.2/share.
inputs.nci_treatment: Kingsoft Corp owns 52% of Kingsoft Office (688111.SH; FY2025 AR subsidiaries note, 3888.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:4546), which generates the office segment (61% of revenue, 86% of FY2025 segment profit, >100% in H1 FY2026 when games lost money). The 48% minority is charged ONCE per component: (1) FLOWS are made attributable-only by folding the NCI share of operating profit into cash_tax_rate_path -- ~17% cash tax + 48% x ~80-85% office share of EBIT = ~40% leakage, combined ~50% in base (46% bull where 100%-owned games recover, 56% bear where all profit sits in Kingsoft Office); FY0 tie: FY2025 EBIT 1,775 x 50% = 888 vs reported adjusted attributable profit ex the parent share of after-tax finance income ~850 -- within noise. (2) The minority's claim on the consolidated cash pile (most of the 27.2bn sits inside Kingsoft Office) is deducted in equity_bridge at NCI book value RMB7,986.2m (30 June 2026), which approximates the minority's share of Kingsoft Office's net assets because those net assets are predominantly net financial assets. The NCI stock is NOT deducted at market value (48% x RMB109.7bn = ~RMB52.7bn), because the flows already carry the minority's share of future operating profit; doing both would charge it twice.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, 10-year horizon (adjusted EBITDA margin still ramping from 23% toward 30% at year 5). Operating software/games company, not a bank/REIT/LIC; first valuation of this ticker (no memory entry). STRUCTURAL BREAKS excluded from the operating base: FY2018-19 consolidated Kingsoft Cloud (negative margins, heavy capex) -- not blended into margin history; FY2020 net income includes ~RMB8.4bn deemed-disposal gain on Kingsoft Cloud deconsolidation; FY2022 loss of RMB6.0bn driven by associate losses/impairments; FY2025 includes RMB1,252.5m net other gain from Kingsoft Cloud dilution; H1 FY2026 includes RMB2,362.9m share-of-JV gain (parent 1,639 reported vs 581 adjusted). All sit below operating profit and never enter the EBITDA-margin flows. EBITDA MARGIN DEFINITION: ebitda_margin_path is adjusted EBITDA BEFORE SBC (the engine deducts SBC separately): FY2025 = operating profit 1,775 + SBC 296 + D&A 250 = 2,321 = 24.0% of revenue; H1 FY2026 = segment results 809 + SBC 182 + D&A 149 = 1,140 = 23.1%. History (pre-SBC): FY2021 28.1%, FY2022 31.5%, FY2023 32.6%, FY2024 40.2% (games peak, JX3 Ultimate), FY2025 24.0%. OWNER FCF: last_fcf = reported FCF 1,949.5 - SBC 296.5 - interest income 660.3 = 992.8 (CONSOLIDATED basis; the projections are attributable via the leakage driver, so year-1 projected FCF of ~RMB0.95bn is below the consolidated anchor by construction). Interest income is stripped because net cash (26.9bn) is ~27x the FCF base and the cash is added in the bridge. MATCHING ASSETS: Kingsoft Cloud (associate, share of losses excluded from EBITDA) added at today's market value; other JVs/associates (ex-Cloud) at 50% of carrying value -- see equity_bridge notes. BUYBACKS exceed SBC, flat count funded. HOLDCO CROSS-CHECK: the 52% Kingsoft Office stake alone is worth ~RMB57bn at 688111.SH's 2026-10-22 close (236.88 x 463.2m shares x 52%), versus a 3888.HK market cap of ~RMB28bn; the market applies a very large holdco discount, so the DCF's upside is mainly the look-through gap, not aggressive operating assumptions. NO numeric FY2026 guidance: management guidance is qualitative (office double-digit growth, games 'will take time'); H1 FY2026 actuals (revenue +6%, office +25%, games -19%, adjusted attributable profit -13%) anchor the FY2026 driver year.
inputs.segment_anchor: FY2025 segment revenue: office 5,928.7 (+16%), games 3,754.1 (-28%). FY2025 segment results (adjusted PBT, ties to operating profit): office 1,531.9, games 241.9. H1 FY2026: office revenue 3,313.3 (+24.7%), games 1,613.9 (-18.8%); segment results office 872.9, games -63.7. Base-case blended growth path is a two-segment build: office +22% FY2026 decelerating to +4.5% by year 10, games -15% FY2026 then +3%/yr; office reaches ~78% of revenue by year 10.

equity_bridge.note: 1,492,621,584 shares (interim report, 30 June 2026) x HKD4.235 (Yahoo 3896.HK close 2026-10-22) = HKD6,321.3m / 1.1739 = RMB5,384.9m. Reported fair value was RMB6,133.5m at 30 June 2026 and RMB7,428.4m at 31 Dec 2025; carrying amount RMB2,915.0m. Its income (share of losses, -418.7m H1 FY2026) is excluded from the flows, so the asset enters the bridge at value (matching-asset rule). Parent-level holding, no NCI share.

equity_bridge.item: Non-controlling interests' claim on consolidated net cash (NCI at book)
equity_bridge.note: NCI book value at 30 June 2026 (interim balance sheet). Proxy for the 48% minority's share of Kingsoft Office's net assets, which are predominantly the cash and wealth-management products that make up most of the consolidated RMB27.2bn cash resources. The flows already carry the minority's share of future operating profit (see nci_treatment), so this deduction covers only the asset stock -- not a second charge.

equity_bridge.item: Other joint ventures and associates ex Kingsoft Cloud, 50% of carrying value
equity_bridge.note: Investments in JVs 3,075.3 + associates 4,674.0 - Kingsoft Cloud carrying 2,915.0 = 4,834.3 at 30 June 2026, taken at 50% = 2,417.1. Their share of profit is excluded from EBITDA, so the matching-asset rule puts them in the bridge; the 50% haircut reflects that these investees sit largely inside Kingsoft Office (the H1 FY2026 RMB2.36bn JV gain split ~48/52 between NCI and parent, confirming the location) so ~48% belongs to minorities, plus illiquidity. Judgment, stated; full carrying value would add ~RMB1.8/share (HKD2.1).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case average revenue growth over the first five forecast years (two-segment build: office mid/high-teens decelerating, games flat after FY2026). Equity CAGR is unusable as a growth anchor here: the FY2020 base is inflated by the RMB8.4bn Cloud deconsolidation gain and FY2022 is depressed by the RMB6.0bn associate-loss year.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-yr CAGR 1.1% diverges >30% from revenue 5-yr CAGR 11.6% and 3-yr equity CAGR 10.1%: the divergence is one-off driven (FY2020 Cloud gain lifted the FY2020 equity base; FY2022 associate losses cut it), not a signal about the operating business. EPS CAGRs are meaningless for the same reason (FY2020 EPS 7.32 one-off, FY2022 EPS -4.45); eps_3yr_cagr is null because the FY2022 base is negative.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are FY2022->FY2025 (3-yr) and FY2020->FY2025 (5-yr). Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income), RMB m: FY2020 1,840; FY2021 1,281; FY2022 1,355; FY2023 2,072; FY2024 3,164; FY2025 993. Owner-FCF CAGRs (-9.8% / -11.6%) sit well below reported-FCF CAGRs (-1.9% / -4.5%): interest income on the growing cash pile (438m -> 660m) and SBC (179m -> 296m) are a rising share of reported FCF, and FY2025 reported FCF fell 53% on the games-segment profit collapse (segment result 2,200 -> 242) plus working-capital reversal. FY2024 was a games peak year (JX3 Ultimate), not a base.

base.growth_note: FY2026 +7% = office +22% (H1 actual +24.7%, Q2 WPS 365 +61%) and games -15% (H1 -18.8%, Goose Goose Duck ramping but co-published/net-recognised). Then office +15/13/11/9/7/6/5.5/5/4.5 and games +3%/yr: blended 9.5 -> 4.5.
base.margin_note: Pre-SBC adjusted EBITDA: FY2025 24.0%, H1 FY2026 23.1%. FY2026 23% holds the AI/R&D investment phase (R&D +16% FY2025) and a loss-making games half; recovers to 30% by year 7 as office scales (Kingsoft Office's own pre-SBC operating margin is ~30%) and games returns to a modest profit. Below the FY2021-23 range of 28-33% until year 6; never revisits the FY2024 40% games peak.
base.tax_note: Combined cash tax + NCI leakage, see inputs.nci_treatment: ~17% cash tax (preferential 10-15% software/high-tech rates plus dividend withholding; FY2025 cash tax 392m on core PBT ~2.4bn = 16-18%) and 48% x ~80-85% office share of EBIT. Held flat: games recovery (100%-owned) lowers leakage while Kingsoft Office outgrowing the group raises it; the two offset.
base.wc_note: Contract liabilities (deferred revenue) rose RMB501m in FY2025 and RMB749m in FY2024 on WPS subscription prepayments; 20% capture on the total revenue change is conservative relative to the 40-57% observed in FY2023-24, because the deferred-revenue tailwind is an office-segment phenomenon and a growing share of office growth is enterprise seats billed in arrears.
base.capex_da_note: Capex 3.5% FY2025, 2.3% H1 FY2026, 4.1% FY2024; D&A 2.6% FY2025, 3.0% H1 FY2026 (includes ROU depreciation). Capex held slightly above D&A for a growing software estate; Kingsoft Cloud's AI infrastructure capex is NOT here (deconsolidated 2020).

bull.tax_note: Leakage falls to ~35% as the 100%-owned games segment returns to a 25-30% share of EBIT (Goose Goose Duck + Angry Birds + Starsand Island), combined ~46%.

bear.tax_note: Games stays at or below breakeven (as in H1 FY2026), so effectively all EBIT sits inside 52%-owned Kingsoft Office: leakage 48%, combined ~56%.

scenario_narratives.base: WPS keeps compounding on the Xinchuang government/SOE substitution base and WPS 365 enterprise seats (+61% in Q2 FY2026), with overseas subscribers (2.85m, +64%) and AI features (WPS AI MAU 80m+) adding ARPU slowly rather than suddenly: office revenue +22% in FY2026 decelerating to mid-single digits by year 10. Games bottoms in FY2026 (-15%) as JX-franchise decay is partly offset by Goose Goose Duck, then grows ~3%/yr off a smaller base and returns to a modest profit. Group pre-SBC EBITDA margin recovers from 23% to 30% by year 7 as the R&D/AI investment phase matures. About half of operating profit leaks to Kingsoft Office's 48% minority. Net cash of RMB26.9bn (less the minority's RMB8.0bn share) and the Kingsoft Cloud stake are the larger part of value; the holdco discount to the look-through Kingsoft Office stake is the gap the market is pricing.
scenario_narratives.bull: AI monetisation lands: WPS Lingxi/Comate 'subscription + AI usage' pricing lifts individual and enterprise ARPU, WPS 365 keeps growing 40%+ as it moves beyond central SOEs into private and local-government accounts, and overseas WPS compounds from a small base, so office grows 25% then high-teens for several years. Goose Goose Duck sustains top-tier China MAU and the two Angry Birds titles clear NPPA approval and launch in 2026-27, returning the 100%-owned games segment to a 25-30% share of EBIT and cutting NCI leakage to ~35%. Margins reach 34% pre-SBC. Kingsoft Cloud re-rates on AI compute demand (its stake is carried at today's market price, so that upside is not in the number).
scenario_narratives.bear: Xinchuang procurement saturates and DingTalk/Feishu/Tencent Docs take enterprise collaboration budgets, so office growth fades to low teens then single digits while AI R&D spend is not recovered through pricing; Microsoft Copilot sets a price-performance bar WPS cannot match overseas. The JX franchise keeps decaying, Goose Goose Duck fades as a fad, Angry Birds approvals slip, and games stays at or below breakeven (as in H1 FY2026), so effectively all operating profit sits inside 52%-owned Kingsoft Office (leakage 48%). Margins stay near 22-24%. The cash pile is largely trapped inside Kingsoft Office and only reaches 3888.HK shareholders through Kingsoft Office dividends (RMB516m paid to NCI in FY2025 implies ~RMB560m up to the parent), and the RMB3.8bn unhedged non-RMB position adds FX noise.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the 15/50/35 default to 25/50/25. Bear up to 25%: the games segment was already loss-making in H1 FY2026, adjusted attributable profit fell 13% YoY, and the office franchise depends on a single policy tailwind (Xinchuang) plus unproven AI pricing. Bull down to 25%: it needs three independent things to go right at once (AI ARPU, overseas scale, and a games pipeline the company has not delivered since JX3 Ultimate). Base at 50% because H1 FY2026 office growth (+25%) and the cash position make the central path well evidenced.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Kingsoft is valued as an operating software company on attributable owner FCF (SBC expensed, interest income stripped, the 48% Kingsoft Office minority's share of profit folded into the tax/leakage driver), plus a bridge that adds management-defined cash resources, deducts the minority's claim on that cash at NCI book, and adds the Kingsoft Cloud stake and other investees at marked value. The one-off gains that dominate reported net income (FY2020 RMB8.4bn, FY2025 RMB1.25bn, H1 FY2026 RMB2.36bn) never enter the flows. Most of the intrinsic value is balance sheet, not operations; the operating business is priced by the market at a low single-digit multiple of attributable adjusted earnings because of the holdco discount to the separately listed Kingsoft Office. The DCF measures look-through intrinsic value and says nothing about when, or whether, that discount closes; the hurdle entry price is the price at which the investor is paid 15% to wait.
key_risks_to_valuation: Holdco discount persists: the look-through value of the 52% Kingsoft Office stake (~RMB57bn at market) already exceeds 3888.HK's market cap; nothing in the DCF forces convergence, and the cash is largely inside Kingsoft Office, reachable only via its dividends.

NCI leakage judgment: the combined 50% tax+leakage rate rests on the office segment staying ~80-85% of EBIT; if games never recovers, leakage is ~48% on all profit (bear 56% combined), and if Kingsoft Office keeps outgrowing the group the base rate drifts up over the horizon.
Games single-IP decay: FY2025 games revenue -28%, H1 FY2026 -19% and a segment loss; Goose Goose Duck's durability and NPPA approvals for the Angry Birds titles are unproven.
AI monetisation: R&D +16% in FY2025 with WPS AI MAU +307% but no disclosed AI revenue; base margins assume this investment is recovered through pricing by year 5-7.

FX and marks: the fx_rate (CNY->HKD 1.1739) and the Kingsoft Cloud market value (RMB5.4bn, down from 7.4bn at FY2025 year-end) are dated 2026-10-22 and move daily; refresh_price.py updates the price but not the fx_rate.
Bridge haircut on other JVs/associates (50% of RMB4.8bn carrying) and NCI-at-book as the proxy for the minority's share of cash are stated judgments worth roughly +/- HKD2-3/share between them.
